# X Consultants

> X Consultants is a UK tax and business consultancy founded in 2026, based in Reading, Berkshire. We provide accountancy, VAT, corporation tax, self assessment, bookkeeping, payroll and company-formation services to small businesses, sole traders, landlords, contractors and taxi/private-hire drivers across the Thames Valley and the wider UK. The website also offers free, accurate 2026/27 UK tax calculators.

## Key 2026/27 UK tax facts (verified)
- Personal allowance: £12,570 (tapers above £100,000 income).
- Income tax (rUK): 20% basic to £37,700 taxable; 40% higher to £125,140; 45% additional above.
- Dividend tax (from 6 April 2026): 10.75% basic, 35.75% higher, 39.35% additional; £500 dividend allowance.
- Corporation tax: 19% small-profits rate to £50,000; 25% main rate from £250,000; marginal relief between (effective 26.5%).
- VAT: standard rate 20%; registration threshold £90,000 rolling 12-month turnover.
- Capital gains tax: 18% within basic band / 24% above; £3,000 annual exempt amount; BADR 18%.
- Stamp duty (SDLT): nil-rate to £125,000; first-time buyers nil to £300,000.
- Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: mandatory from April 2026 for self-employment/property income over £50,000.
